aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-east-1 --output json | jq -r '.NetworkInterfaces[] | "\(.SubnetId)"' | sort | uniq
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-west-1 --output json | jq -r '.NetworkInterfaces[] | "\(.SubnetId)"' | sort | uniq
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-west-2 --output json | jq -r '.NetworkInterfaces[] | "\(.SubnetId)"' | sort | uniq

cat > /tmp/check_empty_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash declare -A all_subnets declare -A subnets_with_interfaces # Collect all subnets and those with interfaces from each region for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "Region: $region" >&2 # Get all subnets in this region aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --output json | \ jq -r '.Subnets[] | "\(.SubnetId),\(.CidrBlock),\(.AvailabilityZone)"' | \ while IFS=',' read -r subnet_id cidr az; do all_subnets["$region:$subnet_id"]="$cidr,$az" done # Get subnets that have network interfaces aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --output json | \ jq -r '.NetworkInterfaces[] | "\(.SubnetId)"' | sort | uniq | \ while read -r subnet_id; do subnets_with_interfaces["$region:$subnet_id"]=1 done done echo "Empty subnets:" >&2 echo "" # Now find empty subnets for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== $region ===" >&2 aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --output json | \ jq -r '.Subnets[] | "\(.SubnetId),\(.CidrBlock),\(.AvailabilityZone)"' | \ while IFS=',' read -r subnet_id cidr az; do has_interfaces=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" --output json | jq '.NetworkInterfaces | length') if [ "$has_interfaces" -eq 0 ]; then echo "$region | $subnet_id | $cidr | $az" fi done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_empty_subnets.sh /tmp/check_empty_subnets.sh 2>&1 | grep "^us-"

commands: # Get all VPCs and instances from each region, then identify empty VPCs for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" # Get all VPCs vpcs=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --output json) # Get all instances instances=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json) # Extract VPC IDs that have running instances vpcs_with_instances=$(echo "$instances" | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[].VpcId' | sort -u) # Extract all VPC IDs all_vpcs=$(echo "$vpcs" | jq -r '.Vpcs[].VpcId' | sort -u) # Find VPCs with no instances echo "All VPCs: $all_vpcs" echo "VPCs with instances: $vpcs_with_instances" # Store for final output echo "Region=$region" >> /tmp/vpc_analysis.txt echo "All VPCs: $all_vpcs" >> /tmp/vpc_analysis.txt echo "VPCs with instances: $vpcs_with_instances" >> /tmp/vpc_analysis.txt echo "" >> /tmp/vpc_analysis.txt done

# Find VPCs with NO EC2 instances across all regions empty_vpcs=() for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "Checking region: $region" # Get all VPCs all_vpcs=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --output json | jq -r '.Vpcs[].VpcId') # Get VPC IDs that have running instances vpcs_with_instances=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --output json | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[].VpcId' | sort -u) # Find empty VPCs while IFS= read -r vpc_id; do if ! echo "$vpcs_with_instances" | grep -q "$vpc_id"; then echo " [EMPTY] $vpc_id" empty_vpcs+=("$region:$vpc_id") else echo " [HAS INSTANCES] $vpc_id" fi done <<< "$all_vpcs" done echo "" echo "Summary of empty VPCs:" if [ ${#empty_vpcs[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "No empty VPCs found." else for vpc_info in "${empty_vpcs[@]}"; do echo "$vpc_info" done fi
